newsitem.title: USA: U.S. gasoline under siege, margins scraping bottom.
newsitem.headline: U.S. gasoline under siege, margins scraping bottom.

text.p: U.S. gasoline prices are under siege and unlikely to recover soon from the tide of low spot prices, anemic futures values and deteriorating refinery margins, according to traders and analysts.

"Gasoline is trading like a pig," said one Gulf Coast futures broker, who cited Thursday's slim 35-point spread between October and November NYMEX reformulated as evidence of waning support for front-end material.
